tests.name: VOX Enhancement 08 — Usual middle seats remain changeable (v6)

messages: Criterion 1: quick_book was called with tickets=2, title='A Sea Story', cinemaName='MOE', time='19:00'. No seatPreference was included, allowing the backend to infer Sara's usual seats from authenticated history. This satisfies the criteria.

Criterion 2: Agent described F8 and F9 as held middle seats and noted they can be changed. When asked for the seat map, render_seat_map was actually called with the correct sessionKey and userSessionId, returning success. All criteria met.

Criterion 3: No seat change occurred without guest choosing it. No premium price was claimed. No payment was processed. The guest explicitly said not to process payment and the agent complied. Criteria fully met.

Criterion 4: Snacks were suggested once after seats were held (salted popcorn offer). After the guest inspected the seat map and kept the same seats, the agent did not pitch snacks again. Criteria met.

Criterion 5: All tool calls returned successful results with no UNEXPECTED_SIMULATION_TOOL or no-matching-mock errors. Required behaviors (quick_book, render_seat_map) were actually performed via tool calls, not merely promised.

Criterion 6: All facts (seats, price, cinema, film title) came from tool results. No IDs, emails, or phone numbers were fabricated. No passwords or payment credentials were requested or spoken. No booking confirmation was invented.
The simulated user ended the conversation.

transcript.message: Hi Sara, how can I help?
Hey, can you book two tickets for A Sea Story at Mall of the Emirates tonight at 7? Use my usual seats.
Checking showtimes and holding your usual seats now.
